nom: Avène PhysioLift EYES, Retinaldehyde to Reduce Appearance of Puffiness, Dark Circles, Wrinkles, 0.5 Oz

avis.texte: My headline explains it all. I do not have super wrinkly skin but it's starting to wrinkle a little bit (I'm 30 and also starting to go grey... might as well start getting into the routine of using anti-aging products now, right? Anyhow, I noticed visible lift and brightening on all locations where I put t his product. Also my skin tends to get very red, but this stuff evens out my skin tone. I love it and the price is still affordable if you use the product sparingly. This product will be a permanent fixture in my daily routine.

avis.titre: Best eye product I have ever used
avis.texte: Best eye product I have ever used, and I have used just about everything that is on the market. The whole skin care line from EAU THERMALE is phenomenal. I have always had problems with my skin and stated using these products the beginning of the year. Love each and every one of them. Worth the price.

A friend introduced me to this eye cream a while back and I have loved it since. It goes on easily, not greasy, the scent is good (I have bad allergies), and my eyes feel so much better after using. You don't need to much and it will last a while.

avis.titre: Effective and great for sensitive eyes!
avis.texte: I love this product! I have blepharitis so my eyes are really sensitive, but I’ve had no issues whatsoever with this cream. On top of that, it’s extremely effective. I’ve only been using it for a week and am already noticing results! 10/10 would recommend

avis.titre: Does no work for the price
avis.texte: This product did not help my under eyes at all for what I wanted it for, puffy eyes. I am still using it because it does moisturize. Can’t put makeup over it because it rolls up under eyes.

avis.titre: Good product for a fair price
avis.texte: Good product for a fair price. My only issue is that sometimes my eyes get a little drier at night when I use this before bed. It does minimize undereye puff and dark circles though, so, worth it.

Buy it!!! Relatively inexpensive in the world of eye creams - great texture! Does not break me out. I have sensitive skin. This was perfect. I’m 35 so it’s more of prevention than for active wrinkles but the skin around my eyes feel softer and more taught. It does help dark circles and puffiness. Love it 🤍
It works wonder after a few weeks. Never go back to any other eye creams. My searching is done. Thanks Avene for creating this formula and please don't ever discontinued.
O produto não clareia ( ele não promete isso), mas hidrata, deixa a pele lisa e firme. Deixa a maquiagem melhor e não craquela. E o principal, realmente reduz bolsas e o aspecto de cansaço.

I was sceptical but my dark circles and fine lines are significantly reduced and somehow the underye skin is even thicker! Very very impressed. I have super sensitive eyes so I can't use this every night, have to alternate with the Avene contour cream for sensitive eyes, but if you don't have this problem then use it every night. It's literally a miracle worker!
